import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

# Load
df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv'))

# Light cleanup for string columns used downstream
for col in [
    'team1','team2','winner','toss_winner','toss_decision','result',
    'super_over','method','match_type','date'
]:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)

# Parse and normalize key fields
df['date_parsed'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')
season_num = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce')
# ASSERTION_START
assert df['date_parsed'].notna().all()
assert season_num.notna().all()
assert ((season_num >= 2008) & (season_num <= 2024)).all()
assert (season_num.astype(int) == df['date_parsed'].dt.year).all()
# ASSERTION_END
df['season_num'] = season_num.astype(int)

# match_type validations used for league share and filtering
allowed_match_types = {
    'League','Qualifier 1','Qualifier 2','Eliminator','Final','Semi Final','Elimination Final','3rd Place Play-Off'
}
# ASSERTION_START
mt = df['match_type']
assert mt.notna().all()
assert mt.isin(allowed_match_types).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Basic structural checks for team pairing
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Result-category checks used for winner logic and margin math
allowed_results = {'runs','wickets','tie','no result'}
# ASSERTION_START
assert df['result'].isin(allowed_results).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Winner constraints conditional on result type
is_result_match = df['result'].isin(['runs','wickets'])
# ASSERTION_START
assert df.loc[is_result_match, 'winner'].notna().all()
assert ((df.loc[is_result_match, 'winner'] == df.loc[is_result_match, 'team1']) | (df.loc[is_result_match, 'winner'] == df.loc[is_result_match, 'team2'])).all()
mask_tie_nr = df['result'].isin(['tie','no result'])
assert df.loc[mask_tie_nr, 'winner'].isna().all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Toss constraints used for toss-effect analytics
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((df['toss_winner'] == df['team1']) | (df['toss_winner'] == df['team2'])).all()
assert df['toss_decision'].isin(['bat','field']).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Margin constraints used for margin-based KPIs
rm = pd.to_numeric(df['result_margin'], errors='coerce')
# ASSERTION_START
wkt_mask = df['result'].eq('wickets')
run_mask = df['result'].eq('runs')
assert rm[wkt_mask].notna().all() and rm[run_mask].notna().all()
assert np.isclose(rm[wkt_mask], np.floor(rm[wkt_mask])).all()
assert np.isclose(rm[run_mask], np.floor(rm[run_mask])).all()
assert ((rm[wkt_mask] >= 1) & (rm[wkt_mask] <= 10)).all()
assert (rm[run_mask] >= 1).all()
other_mask = df['result'].isin(['tie','no result'])
assert rm[other_mask].isna().all()
# ASSERTION_END
df['result_margin_num'] = rm

# Super over constraints used for super-over rates
# ASSERTION_START
so = df['super_over']
assert so.isin(['Y','N']).all()
assert ((df['result'] == 'tie') == (so == 'Y')).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# D/L and target overs constraints used for detecting D/L-affected matches
to = pd.to_numeric(df['target_overs'], errors='coerce')
m = df['method']
# ASSERTION_START
assert (m.isna() | m.eq('D/L')).all()
assert to.notna().all()
assert ((to > 0) & (to <= 20)).all()
assert ((m.eq('D/L')) == (to < 20)).all()
assert ((m.isna()) == (to == 20)).all()
# ASSERTION_END
df['target_overs_num'] = to

# Build long frame with one row per team per match
base_cols = ['season_num','team1','team2','winner','result','result_margin_num','toss_winner','toss_decision','super_over','method','target_overs_num','match_type']
A = df[base_cols].copy()
B = df[base_cols].copy()
A = A.rename(columns={'team1': 'team', 'team2': 'opponent'})
B = B.rename(columns={'team2': 'team', 'team1': 'opponent'})
long_df = pd.concat([A.assign(side=1), B.assign(side=2)], ignore_index=True)

# Outcome flags
long_df['is_result'] = long_df['result'].isin(['runs','wickets'])
long_df['is_win'] = long_df['is_result'] & (long_df['winner'] == long_df['team'])
long_df['is_loss'] = long_df['is_result'] & (~long_df['is_win'])
long_df['win_by_runs'] = long_df['is_win'] & long_df['result'].eq('runs')
long_df['win_by_wickets'] = long_df['is_win'] & long_df['result'].eq('wickets')
long_df['run_margin_val'] = np.where(long_df['win_by_runs'], long_df['result_margin_num'], np.nan)
long_df['wickets_margin_val'] = np.where(long_df['win_by_wickets'], long_df['result_margin_num'], np.nan)

# Toss-effect flags
long_df['won_toss'] = (long_df['toss_winner'] == long_df['team'])
long_df['won_after_winning_toss'] = long_df['won_toss'] & long_df['is_win']
long_df['toss_field'] = long_df['won_toss'] & long_df['toss_decision'].eq('field')
long_df['toss_field_win'] = long_df['toss_field'] & long_df['is_win']

# Aggregate per-season per-team performance
grp = long_df.groupby(['season_num','team'], as_index=False)
team_stats = grp.agg(
    matches=('team','size'),
    wins=('is_win','sum'),
    result_matches=('is_result','sum'),
    wins_by_runs=('win_by_runs','sum'),
    wins_by_wickets=('win_by_wickets','sum'),
    avg_win_margin_runs=('run_margin_val','mean'),
    avg_wickets_margin=('wickets_margin_val','mean'),
    toss_won_matches=('won_toss','sum'),
    wins_when_won_toss=('won_after_winning_toss','sum'),
    toss_field_matches=('toss_field','sum'),
    toss_field_wins=('toss_field_win','sum')
)

# Rates
team_stats['win_pct'] = np.where(team_stats['result_matches'] == 0, np.nan, team_stats['wins'] / team_stats['result_matches'])
team_stats['toss_win_rate'] = np.where(team_stats['toss_won_matches'] == 0, np.nan, team_stats['wins_when_won_toss'] / team_stats['toss_won_matches'])
team_stats['win_rate_when_fielding_after_toss'] = np.where(team_stats['toss_field_matches'] == 0, np.nan, team_stats['toss_field_wins'] / team_stats['toss_field_matches'])

# League-level analytics per season
def season_agg(x: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    total = len(x)
    result_mask = x['result'].isin(['runs','wickets'])
    toss_match_win_rate = (x.loc[result_mask, 'toss_winner'] == x.loc[result_mask, 'winner']).mean() if result_mask.any() else np.nan
    return pd.Series({
        'total_matches': total,
        'dl_affected_matches': (x['target_overs_num'] < 20).sum(),
        'dl_rate': (x['target_overs_num'] < 20).mean(),
        'super_over_count': (x['super_over'] == 'Y').sum(),
        'super_over_rate': (x['super_over'] == 'Y').mean(),
        'field_first_share': (x['toss_decision'] == 'field').mean(),
        'toss_winner_match_win_rate': toss_match_win_rate,
        'league_share': (x['match_type'] == 'League').mean(),
        'tie_rate': (x['result'] == 'tie').mean(),
        'no_result_rate': (x['result'] == 'no result').mean()
    })

season_analytics = df.groupby('season_num').apply(season_agg).reset_index()

# Output
team_stats = team_stats.sort_values(['season_num','team']).reset_index(drop=True)
team_stats.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'team_metrics_per_season.csv'), index=False)
season_analytics = season_analytics.sort_values('season_num').reset_index(drop=True)
season_analytics.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'league_analytics_by_season.csv'), index=False)
